summary: Frontend mobile retest completed at 375x667. Fresh dashboard, modal scrolling/save reachability, Gaji/Bonus, expense save, navigation, history filters, and web local persistence were exercised.

integration_issues.issue: The add-transaction modal retains the previous kind. After saving an income and opening it again, it remains on Pemasukan and Makanan is unavailable until Pengeluaran is tapped.

action_items: Reset modal kind to expense when the modal closes or after a transaction is saved, so each new transaction starts with expense categories.
critical_code_review_comments: Navigation and storage flows are functional; interactive navigation controls do not currently expose testID attributes, which reduces automated testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, modal scrolling and save reachability pass. Gaji and Bonus render in income mode. Expense Makanan save, all four tabs, all three history filters, and reload persistence pass. Separate browser runs do not share state, so verify income+expense balance in one context.
rca_of_issue: AddTransactionModal initializes kind once with useState("expense") but does not reset it when visible changes or after close. The kind effect only resets category when kind changes, so reopening after income leaves income categories selected.
